verdict.rationale: Airbyte's Connector Builder is a documented no-code/low-code tool for building custom connectors for long-tail APIs directly in the UI, with AI Assistant support to speed up config, explicitly positioned as an alternative to forking/maintaining custom code ("you don't build or maintain API wrappers"). This is a first-party supported path, not a fork, matching the story well. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of building a connector for a truly obscure/long-tail API and confirmation of publishing/maintaining it in the catalog long-term.
